instructions: Copy entry_template into resources for each selected component, asset or example. Fill only observed facts; remove entry_template and instructions in the project copy. Use project-relative local paths. Distinguish kind: base_ui, engine, visual_component, example, media, font. role describes its actual job; visible_result describes what a user can observe, not merely that a package loaded. Status: candidate, acquired, integrated, verified. Do not record account secrets or signed URLs. reuse_class: asset, component, adaptation, integration; upstream_file_or_export identifies the actual implementation. Record visual_core_modified honestly. Motion verification needs a real trigger and perceptible_result; a running engine is insufficient.
